name.quote: The board consists of five (5) members appointed by the governor

type.quote: The board consists of five (5) members appointed by the governor. Subject to IC 25-1-6.5-3, four (4) members must be licensed podiatrists who actively practice podiatric medicine

degree_required.value: Doctor of Podiatric Medicine from a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education
degree_required.quote: has graduated with a degree of doctor of podiatric medicine from a college or school of podiatric medicine approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

accrediting_body.quote: approved by the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

required.quote: has satisfactorily completed at least twelve (12) months of progressive graduate podiatric medical training that meets the requirements of the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

duration.quote: at least twelve (12) months of progressive graduate podiatric medical training

kind.quote: progressive graduate podiatric medical training that meets the requirements of the Council on Podiatric Medical Education

exams.name: Board-approved examination
exams.quote: has taken and successfully completed an examination approved by the board

interval_years.quote: a license to practice podiatric medicine expires on a date established by the agency under IC 25-1-5-4 in each odd-numbered year

required.quote: evidence of the podiatrist's maintenance of professional medical competence, which may include continuing podiatric medical education, postgraduate studies, institutes, seminars, lectures, conferences, work shops, professional evaluation, and specialty board certification or recertification during the preceding four (4) years

available.quote: The board may issue a license to an applicant who pays a fee established by the board and who presents satisfactory evidence to the board that the applicant meets the requirements under IC 25-29-3-1

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed in a state, territory, or possession of the United States; has passed a podiatric medical licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination approved by the board; and has practiced podiatric medicine for at least five (5) years
requirements.quote: is licensed in a state, territory, or possession of the United States; has passed a podiatric medical licensing examination that is substantially equivalent to the examination approved by the board; and has practiced podiatric medicine for at least five (5) years

regulatory_model.quote: A person that knowingly engages or aids and abets another person, in the practice of podiatric medicine without a license issued under this article commits unauthorized practice of podiatric medicine, a Level 6 felony

credential_type.quote: An individual who applies for a license to practice podiatric medicine must present satisfactory evidence to the board

is_mandatory.quote: A person that knowingly engages or aids and abets another person, in the practice of podiatric medicine without a license issued under this article commits unauthorized practice of podiatric medicine, a Level 6 felony

title_protection.quote: Podiatrist means an individual who practices podiatric medicine and uses one (1) or more of the following designations: Doctor of podiatric medicine, Podiatric physician, Podiatric surgeon

scope_protection.quote: A person that knowingly engages or aids and abets another person, in the practice of podiatric medicine without a license issued under this article commits unauthorized practice of podiatric medicine

disciplinary_grounds.description: Podiatrist is impaired from practicing with reasonable skill and safety because of mental illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that a podiatrist is impaired from practicing podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of a mental illness

disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that a podiatrist is impaired from practicing podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of a physical illness

disciplinary_grounds.description: Podiatrist is impaired from practicing with reasonable skill and safety because of excessive use or habitual abuse of a controlled substance
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that a podiatrist is impaired from practicing podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of an excessive use or habitual abuse of a controlled substance

disciplinary_grounds.description: Podiatrist is impaired from practicing with reasonable skill and safety because of excessive use or habitual abuse of alcohol
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the board determines that a podiatrist is impaired from practicing podiatric medicine with reasonable skill and safety because of alcohol

definition_quote.value: Podiatric medicine means the diagnosis or medical, surgical, and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures
definition_quote.quote: Podiatric medicine means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures

methods_authorized.quote: "Podiatric medicine" means the diagnosis or medical, surgical (as described in IC 25-22.5-1-1.1(a)(1)(C)), and mechanical treatment of the human foot and related structures. Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics.

amputation_authorized.quote: The term does not include the amputation of the entire foot, but does include the amputation of an entire toe if the amputation is performed at an institution that is approved by a joint commission of accredited hospital organizations and where comanagement of the patient is being performed by a physician licensed under IC 25-22.5

anesthesia_authority.quote: Podiatric medicine includes the administration of local anesthetics

podiatric_assistant_authorized.quote: An employee of a podiatrist or group of podiatrists who performs an act, a duty, or a function that is customarily within the specific area of practice of the employing podiatrist or group of podiatrists, if the act, duty, or function is performed under the direction and supervision of the employing podiatrist or a podiatrist of the employing group

podiatric_assistant_supervision_level.quote: if the act, duty, or function is performed under the direction and supervision of the employing podiatrist or a podiatrist of the employing group within whose area of practice the act, duty, or function falls

impaired_practitioner_program.quote:
The board may adopt rules that do the following:
(1) Require podiatrists to report an impaired podiatrist to the board.
(2) Approve certain voluntary treatment programs for impaired podiatrists that are medically directed and nonprofit.
